ai_analysis.headline: Video is likely fabricated, based on strong forensic indicators
ai_analysis.summary: Our analysis of the video flagged manipulation signs in every examined frame. With a confidence of about 90%, we conclude the content is fake.

analysis.overview: The system examined 32 frames, applying detection algorithms to look for visual inconsistencies. Each frame was scored for signs of synthetic generation. All frames received high fake scores, and a temporal escalation flag was triggered. No faces were detected, so the model evaluated other visual cues across the frames.
analysis.heatmap_interpretation: The attention map did not isolate a specific area; instead, the model evaluated the entire frame uniformly. This suggests that manipulation cues are spread across the image rather than confined to a localized patch.
analysis.region_focus: No particular region was singled out; the analysis considered the full frame.

observed_indicators: Consistently high manipulation scores across all 32 frames
Uniform temporal pattern typical of synthetic generation
Peak‑frame escalation flag triggered, indicating deepfake artifacts
Absence of natural facial features or detection
Statistical scores well above typical authenticity thresholds
ai_analysis.confidence_statement: The analysis indicates a high level of certainty (≈90%) that the video is fabricated.
ai_analysis.limitations: The tool cannot determine the source of the manipulation or verify content beyond visual cues. It cannot assess audio or external metadata.
ai_analysis.recommendation: Consider a manual review by an expert and cross‑reference with original sources.
